questions.domain: 領域 1：AI 和 ML 基礎 (Fundamentals of AI and ML)

question_text.zh: 一家公司计划为公司的全球客戶群构建一个 AI 模型。公司希望在一个能够反映用戶多样性的数据集上训练该模型。 哪项操作将满足此要求?
question_text.en: A company plans to build an AI model for the company’s global customer base. The company wants to train the model on a dataset that reflects user diversity. Which action will meet this requirement?

A.zh: 在数据集中平衡类别代表性。
A.en: Balance class representation in the dataset.

B.zh: 使用具有完整数据的区域性数据集。
B.en: Use a regional dataset with complete data.

C.zh: 对多数类别数据进行过采样。
C.en: Oversample majority class data.

D.zh: 删除少数类别数据记录。
D.en: Drop minority class data records.

A.zh: 正確。原因是，平衡类别代表性可以让少数类别 /少数群体在训练中获得足够权重与学习机会,有助于模型在不同群体上更一致的表现,从而更好反映用戶多样性(至少在 “类别维度 ”的多样性上)。在考试语境中,这是最符合 “反映多样性 /减少偏差 ”的通用最佳实践表述
A.en: Correct. Choosing this option directly addresses the source-confirmed requirement: Which action will meet this requirement?

B.zh: 錯誤。原因是，题干强调 “全球客戶 ”,而 “区域性数据集 ”天然更可能缺失其他地区 /文化 /语言 /行为的分布特征,即便数据完整,也不代表全球多样性,反而可能引入地域偏差
B.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which action will meet this requirement? The source-supported choice is A. Balance class representation in the dataset..

C.zh: 錯誤。原因是，对多数类过采样会进一步加剧不平衡,使模型更偏向多数类 /主流群体,削弱对少数群体的学习与表现,与 “反映用戶多样性”的目标相反
C.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which action will meet this requirement? The source-supported choice is A. Balance class representation in the dataset..

D.zh: 錯誤。原因是，删除少数类会直接抹掉多样性来源,使训练数据更加单一,模型对少数群体几乎无法学习,偏差与不公平⻛险更大
D.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which action will meet this requirement? The source-supported choice is A. Balance class representation in the dataset..

answer_text.zh: A. 在数据集中平衡类别代表性。
answer_text.en: A. Balance class representation in the dataset.

questions.domain: 領域 2：生成式 AI 基礎 (Fundamentals of GenAI)

question_text.zh: 一家公司希望为数据和 AI 开发实现一个单一环境。不同团队的开发人员必须能够访问该环境并协同工作。开发人员必须能够在该环境中安全地构建和共享模型以及生成式 AI 应用程序。 哪个 AWS 解决方案可以满足这些要求?
question_text.en: A company wants to implement a single environment for both data and AI development. Developers across different teams must be able to access the environment and work together. The developers must be able to build and share models and generative AI applications securely in the environment. Which AWS solution will meet these requirements?

A.zh: 使用 Amazon Lex
A.en: Amazon Lex

B.zh: 统一工作室
B.en: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio

C.zh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock PartyRock
C.en: Amazon Bedrock PartyRock

D.zh: Amazon Q Developer
D.en: Amazon Q Developer

A.zh: 錯誤。原因是，Lex是用来构建聊天机器人(意图识别、对话管理、语音 /文本接口)的托管服务。 它不是 “数据与 AI统一开发环境 ”,也不提供跨团队在同一工作空间中进行数据开发、模型训练、生成式 AI应用搭建与共享的完整协作平台能力
A.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which AWS solution will meet these requirements? The source-supported choice is B. Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio.

B.zh: 正確。原因是，SageMaker Studio/Unified Studio定位就是集中式的 AI/ML开发环境,面向企业团队协作,通常支持在统一界面中进行数据准备、实验、训练、部署、管理与共享。 满足单一环境:把数据与 AI相关工作流集中到一个 Studio/工作室体验中。 满足跨团队协作:可通过工作空间 /项目、共享资产与权限体系支持多团队访问与协作。 满足安全共享:依赖 AWS的身份与访问管理、资源隔离与治理能力,在企业环境中更符合 “安全地构建与共享模型与生成式 AI应用 ”
B.en: Correct. Choosing this option directly addresses the source-confirmed requirement: Which AWS solution will meet these requirements?

C.zh: 錯誤。原因是，PartyRock更偏向快速试玩 /原型体验的低⻔槛生成式 AI应用构建工具。 题干要求 “单一环境覆盖数据与 AI开发 ”“跨团队安全协作与共享 ”,这更像企业级工作平台需求; PartyRock通常不作为企业统一的数据 +AI开发与治理平台来满足这类要求
C.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which AWS solution will meet these requirements? The source-supported choice is B. Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio.

D.zh: 錯誤。原因是，Amazon Q Developer是开发者 AI助手,侧重代码生成、解释、重构、在 IDE/控制台提升开发效率。 它不是一个 “统一的 data + AI 开发环境 /工作室 ”,也不承担模型与生成式 AI应用的端到端构建、资产管理、跨团队共享与治理的主平台⻆色
D.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which AWS solution will meet these requirements? The source-supported choice is B. Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio.

answer_text.zh: B. 统一工作室
answer_text.en: B. Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio

discussion.en: The source community vote distribution is B 100%. The discussion focuses on whether each option satisfies the primary requirement; the final answer follows the source analysis and technical reasoning: B.

question_text.zh: 一家公司部署了一个基础模型( FM)。该公司注意到该 FM 正在生成对用戶提交的有关政治的问题的答案。该公司希望确保该模型不会向用戶发送对政治问题的答案。 哪种 AWS 解决方案将满足此要求?
question_text.en: A company deploys a foundation model (FM). The company notices that the FM is producing answers to user-submitted questions about politics. The company wants to ensure that the model does not send answers to political questions to users. Which AWS solution will meet this requirement?

A.zh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock Guardrails
A.en: Amazon Bedrock Guardrails

B.zh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock Agents
B.en: Amazon Bedrock Agents

C.zh: 使用 Amazon SageMaker Clarify
C.en: Amazon SageMaker Clarify

D.zh: 使用 Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor
D.en: Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor

A.zh: 正確。原因是，Guardrails 设计目的就是对生成式 AI 的输入 /输出实施安全策略与内容治理。 可配置策略以拦截 /拒绝特定主题 (例如政治类话题),从而确保模型不会向用戶返回相关回答。 与题干 “确保模型不把政治问题的答案发给用戶 ”的要求完全匹配
A.en: Correct. Choosing this option directly addresses the source-confirmed requirement: Which AWS solution will meet this requirement?

B.zh: 錯誤。原因是，Agents 主要用于任务编排 (调用工具 /函数、检索知识库、执行多步骤任务),并非专⻔用于内容安全过滤。 虽然可以在业务逻辑里 “自己写规则 ”去拒答政治问题,但题目问的是 “哪个 AWS 解决方案将满足该要求 ”,最贴切的原生治理能力不是 Agents
B.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which AWS solution will meet this requirement? The source-supported choice is A. Amazon Bedrock Guardrails.

C.zh: 錯誤。原因是，Clarify 主要用于偏差检测、可解释性( SHAP 等) 、特征归因,以及部分数据 /模型公平性分析。 它不负责对 LLM 的输出做主题级别的实时拦截,不适合 “禁止回答政治问题 ”的在线内容过滤需求
C.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which AWS solution will meet this requirement? The source-supported choice is A. Amazon Bedrock Guardrails.

D.zh: 錯誤。原因是，Model Monitor 用于监控模型漂移、数据质量、概念漂移以及推理数据统计特征变化等。 它不提供对输出内容进行主题限制 /安全拦截的能力,无法直接阻止政治类回答返回给用戶
D.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which AWS solution will meet this requirement? The source-supported choice is A. Amazon Bedrock Guardrails.

answer_text.zh: A. 使用 Amazon Bedrock Guardrails
answer_text.en: A. Amazon Bedrock Guardrails

questions.domain: 領域 3：基礎模型的應用 (Applications of Foundation Models)

question_text.zh: 一家公司希望将其文档作为大型语言模型( LLM)的知识库,用于检索增强生成( RAG)解决方案。 哪种解决方案将满足这些要求?
question_text.en: A company wants to use its documents as a knowledge base for a large language model (LLM) in a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) solution. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.zh: 使用加密密钥对每个文档进行加密。
A.en: Encrypt each document with encryption keys.

B.zh: 从文档分块创建嵌入向量。
B.en: Create embeddings from document chunks.

C.zh: 使用元数据为文档数据打标签。
C.en: Label the document data with metadata.

D.zh: 为每个文档生成独热编码
D.en: Generate one-hot encoding for each document

A.zh: 錯誤。原因是，加密解决的是数据静态存储安全与合规 (confidentiality),并不能让系统具备 “语义检索 ”能力。 在 RAG 中可能需要加密,但它不是 “用作知识库 ”的关键实现步骤,且加密后的内容还需要解密 /可处理才能生成向量与检索
A.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which solution will meet these requirements? The source-supported choice is B. Create embeddings from document chunks..

B.zh: 正確。原因是，RAG 的检索阶段通常对 “chunk”级别进行向量化,因为: 整篇文档太⻓,容易超出模型上下文窗口或降低检索精度。 分块后可更精确定位相关段落,提高检索召回与答案相关性。 embeddings 使得可以用向量相似度做语义检索,从而把相关片段送入 LLM 作为上下文
B.en: Correct. Choosing this option directly addresses the source-confirmed requirement: Which solution will meet these requirements?

C.zh: 錯誤。此選項不能完整滿足題目的主要要求；相較之下，來源確認的適當答案是 B. 从文档分块创建嵌入向量。。
C.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which solution will meet these requirements? The source-supported choice is B. Create embeddings from document chunks..

D.zh: 錯誤。原因是，独热编码维度巨大、稀疏、不能表达语义相似性,不适合语义检索;也无法有效支持 RAG 所需的向量相似度检索体验。 RAG 需要 dense embeddings(稠密向量)来表达语义
D.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which solution will meet these requirements? The source-supported choice is B. Create embeddings from document chunks..

answer_text.zh: B. 从文档分块创建嵌入向量。
answer_text.en: B. Create embeddings from document chunks.

D.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which AWS service creates business intelligence reports and automatically generates executive summaries based on data that users provide? The source-supported choice is A. Amazon Q in QuickSight.

question_text.zh: 一家公司已经开发了一个神经网络模型来替换现有的决策树模型。与决策树模型相比,神经网络模型具有更高的预测准确率。然而,神经网络模型的决策过程不如决策树模型的决策过程那样可解释。 公司采用神经网络模型是在做出哪种权衡?
question_text.en: A company has developed a neural network model to replace an existing decision tree model. The neural network model has a higher prediction accuracy compared to the decision tree model. However, the neural network model’s decision process is not as explainable as the decision tree model’s decision process. Which tradeoff is the company making by adopting the neural network model?

A.zh: 更高的合规性以换取更低的
A.en: Higher compliance for lower interpretability

B.zh: 更高的性能以换取更低的可移植性
B.en: Higher performance for lower portability

C.zh: 更高的性能以换取更低的
C.en: Higher performance for lower interpretability

D.zh: 更高的可移植性以换取更低的
D.en: Higher portability for lower interpretability

A.zh: 錯誤。原因是，) 错误。题干没有提到合规( Compliance)要求提升或变化;而且通常合规性更依赖可解释性、审计、可追溯等能力,和 “可解释性降低 ”往往是矛盾方向,不是题干所述取舍
A.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which tradeoff is the company making by adopting the neural network model? The source-supported choice is C. Higher performance for lower interpretability.

B.zh: 錯誤。原因是，题干未涉及可移植性( Portability),例如跨平台部署、跨环境迁移、硬件依赖等内容。只讨论了准确率与可解释性
B.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which tradeoff is the company making by adopting the neural network model? The source-supported choice is C. Higher performance for lower interpretability.

C.zh: 正確。原因是，) 正确。题干直接对应:神经网络准确率更高(性能更高),但不如决策树可解释(可解释性更低)
C.en: Correct. Choosing this option directly addresses the source-confirmed requirement: Which tradeoff is the company making by adopting the neural network model?

D.zh: 錯誤。原因是，) 错误。题干没有任何关于可移植性的描述;仅强调性能与可解释性之间的差异
D.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which tradeoff is the company making by adopting the neural network model? The source-supported choice is C. Higher performance for lower interpretability.

question_text.en: A company is using a foundation model (FM) to generate creative marketing slogans for various products. The company wants to reuse a standard template with common instructions when generating slogans for different products. However, the company needs to add short descriptions for each product. Which Amazon Bedrock solution will meet these requirements?

A.zh: 提示词管理
A.en: Prompt management

B.zh: 知识库
B.en: Knowledge Bases

C.zh: 模型评估
C.en: Model evaluation

D.zh: 跨区域推理
D.en: Cross-region inference

question_text.zh: 提高模型透明度会带来哪项结果?
question_text.en: Which outcome is a result of increasing model transparency?

A.zh: 减少对模型验证步骤的需求
A.en: Reduced need for model validation steps

B.zh: 消除对法规合规性监控要求的需要
B.en: Elimination of regulatory compliance monitoring requirements

C.zh: 自动从模型预测中移除所有偏差
C.en: Automatic removal of all bias from model predictions

D.zh: 增强识别偏差并改进模型治理的能力
D.en: Enhanced ability to identify bias and improve model governance

A.zh: 錯誤。原因是，透明性提高并不意味着验证步骤可以减少。验证 (validation)包括性能评估、鲁棒性测试、偏差 /公平性评估、安全与隐私检查、漂移监控策略等。 透明性只能让验证更容易执行、 结果更可解释,但不会降低验证的必要性;在合规要求较强的场景,透明性往往会促进更完善的验证证据链
A.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which outcome is a result of increasing model transparency? The source-supported choice is D. Enhanced ability to identify bias and improve model governance.

B.zh: 錯誤。原因是，合规监控是外部法规与内部制度驱动的要求(例如对高⻛险系统的持续监控、审计记录、模型变更管理等)。 提升透明性可以帮助更好地满足合规与审计 (更容易解释与提供证据),但不可能 “消除 ”监管监控要求
B.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which outcome is a result of increasing model transparency? The source-supported choice is D. Enhanced ability to identify bias and improve model governance.

C.zh: 錯誤。原因是，透明性 ≠去偏算法,更不可能 “自动移除所有偏差 ”。偏差来源可能包括训练数据偏差、采样偏差、标签偏差、代理变量、反馈回路等。 透明性可以帮助发现偏差与定位成因,但需要进一步的数据治理、特征处理、公平性约束、后处理校正、业务规则与人类审查等手段才能缓解偏差
C.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which outcome is a result of increasing model transparency? The source-supported choice is D. Enhanced ability to identify bias and improve model governance.

D.zh: 正確。原因是，透明性提高后,团队更容易理解模型决策逻辑、识别不合理的特征影响与群体差异表现,从而更有效地进行偏差分析与纠正。 同时,透明性也增强了可审计性与可追责性,有助于模型治理(如模型卡 /文档、审批流程、⻛险评估、监控指标设定、审计与复盘)
D.en: Correct. Choosing this option directly addresses the source-confirmed requirement: Which outcome is a result of increasing model transparency?

answer_text.zh: D. 增强识别偏差并改进模型治理的能力
answer_text.en: D. Enhanced ability to identify bias and improve model governance

B.zh: 使用 AWS Trusted Advisor 监控模型输入和输出数据。

question_text.zh: 一家公司在 Amazon VPC 中的服务器上运行一个应用程序。该公司的应用程序使用 Amazon Bedrock API 来实现 AI 功能。该公司不希望 API 调用通过公共互联网传输。 哪种解决方案将满足此要求?
question_text.en: A company runs an application on servers in an Amazon VPC. The company’s application uses Amazon Bedrock APIs for AI features. The company does not want API calls to travel across the public internet. Which solution will meet this requirement?

A.zh: 使用 AWS PrivateLink 在 Amazon VPC 与 Amazon Bedrock 之间建立私有连接。
A.en: Use AWS PrivateLink to establish a private connection between the Amazon VPC and Amazon Bedrock.

B.zh: 通过使用与某个 IAM 主体关联的访问密钥 ID 和私有访问密钥来对 API 请求进行签名。
B.en: Sign API requests by using an access key ID and a secret access key that is associated with an IAM principal.

C.zh: 将应用程序迁移到本地服务器。对 Amazon Bedrock 的公共端点发起 API 调用。
C.en: Move the application to an on-premises server. Make API calls to the public endpoint of Amazon Bedrock.

D.zh: 对从客戶端到在 Amazon VPC 中实现的 API 的传输数据进行加密。对从 Amazon VPC 到 Amazon Bedrock 的 API 调用的传输数据进行加密。
D.en: Encrypt the data in transit from clients to the APIs that have been implemented in the Amazon VPC. Encrypt the data in transit for API calls from the Amazon VPC to Amazon Bedrock.

A.zh: 正確。原因是，PrivateLink(接口型 VPC 端点)可以在 VPC 内创建到 AWS 服务的私有连接路径,使对 Bedrock 的 API 调用通过 AWS 私网 /⻣干网络路由,而不是经由公网出口(如 IGW/NAT 访问公网域名)。满足 “不走公共互联网 ”的要求
A.en: Correct. Choosing this option directly addresses the source-confirmed requirement: Which solution will meet this requirement?

B.zh: 錯誤。原因是，请求签名( SigV4)解决的是身份认证与请求完整性,并不改变网络路径。即使签名了,如果仍访问公共端点,流量仍可能经公网路由(取决于网络架构),不满足题目“不要穿越公共互联网 ”这一核心要求
B.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which solution will meet this requirement? The source-supported choice is A. Use AWS PrivateLink to establish a private connection between the Amazon VPC and Amazon Bedrock..

C.zh: 錯誤。原因是，明确使用公共端点,更不可能避免公共互联网(除非有专线 +私有端点等额外条件,但选项未提供)。而且把应用迁到本地并不能天然解决 “访问 Bedrock 不走公网 ”的问题,反而通常更依赖公网或需要额外专线方案
C.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which solution will meet this requirement? The source-supported choice is A. Use AWS PrivateLink to establish a private connection between the Amazon VPC and Amazon Bedrock..

D.zh: 錯誤。原因是，传输加密( TLS)能保护数据在传输途中不被窃听 /篡改,但并不保证流量不经过公共互联网。 题目关注的是网络路径( private connectivity),不是仅仅 “在公网但加密 ”
D.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which solution will meet this requirement? The source-supported choice is A. Use AWS PrivateLink to establish a private connection between the Amazon VPC and Amazon Bedrock..

answer_text.zh: A. 使用 AWS PrivateLink 在 Amazon VPC 与 Amazon Bedrock 之间建立私有连接。
answer_text.en: A. Use AWS PrivateLink to establish a private connection between the Amazon VPC and Amazon Bedrock.

question_text.zh: 一家金融公司使用一个机器学习模型来检测潜在的欺诈交易。公司需要确保某些类型的预测在公司根据这些预测采取行动之前,先由人工分析师进行审核。 哪种 AWS 解决方案将满足此要求?
question_text.en: A financial company uses an ML model to detect potentially fraudulent transactions. The company needs to ensure that some types of predictions receive review by human analysts before the company acts upon the predictions. Which AWS solution will meet this requirement?

A.zh: 使用 Amazon SageMaker Clarify
A.en: Amazon SageMaker Clarify

B.zh: 使用 Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth
B.en: Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth

C.zh: 使用 Amazon Augmented AI (Amazon A2I)
C.en: Amazon Augmented AI (Amazon A2I)

D.zh: 使用 Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor
D.en: Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor

A.zh: 錯誤。原因是，Clarify主要用于检测 /量化偏差( bias)与生成可解释性( feature attribution, SHAP类),可用于审计与透明度,但它不提供 “对特定预测结果强制走人工复核 ”的工作流能力
A.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which AWS solution will meet this requirement? The source-supported choice is C. Amazon Augmented AI (Amazon A2I).

B.zh: 錯誤。原因是，Ground Truth用于数据标注 (图像 /文本 /视频等)与构建训练数据集;也支持某些主动学习式的标注流程,但其核心是训练数据标注,不是对线上推理预测结果在业务执行前做人工审批
B.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which AWS solution will meet this requirement? The source-supported choice is C. Amazon Augmented AI (Amazon A2I).

C.zh: 正確。原因是，A2I专⻔用于将机器学习预测结果接入人工审核工作流,可以基于置信度阈值、业务规则、抽样策略等决定哪些推理结果需要人工复核,并在复核完成后再将结果返回下游系统采取行动,完全符合 “某些类型预测必须人工审核 ”的要求
C.en: Correct. Choosing this option directly addresses the source-confirmed requirement: Which AWS solution will meet this requirement?

D.zh: 錯誤。原因是，Model Monitor用于监控模型质量 /数据漂移 /概念漂移 、检测推理输入与训练数据分布差异、以及告警与报表;它不提供 “对单次预测结果进行人工复核后再执行 ”的审核编排能力。 4)
D.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which AWS solution will meet this requirement? The source-supported choice is C. Amazon Augmented AI (Amazon A2I).

questions.domain: 領域 2：生成式 AI 基礎 (Fundamentals of GenAI)

question_text.zh: 哪种策略将评估基础模型( FM)在真实世界应用中的性能?
question_text.en: Which strategy will evaluate the performance of a foundation model (FM) in real-world applications?

A.zh: 在受控环境中与用戶进行 A/B 测试
A.en: Conducting A/B testing with users in a controlled environment

B.zh: 由主题领域专家进行人工评估
B.en: Human evaluation by subject matter experts

C.zh: 在训练数据集上衡量模型的准确率
C.en: Measuring the model’s accuracy on a training dataset

D.zh: 分析模型的内部表征和注意力模式
D.en: Analysis of the model’s internal representations and attention patterns

A.zh: 正確。原因是，正确原因: A/B测试属于在线评估 /近真实评估方法:让真实用戶(或代表性用戶)在真实任务场景中使用不同版本,比较关键指标。 “受控环境 ”强调变量可控(例如灰度发布、分流策略、相同流量分配),但评估对象仍是用戶侧真实交互,可反映真实世界使用表现。 相比纯离线指标, A/B测试能捕捉到:提示鲁棒性、用戶意图分布变化、系统延迟、上下游集成、错误恢复等真实因素
A.en: Correct. Choosing this option directly addresses the source-confirmed requirement: Which strategy will evaluate the performance of a foundation model (FM) in real-world applications?

B.zh: 錯誤。原因是，不如 A贴切(偏离线 /实验室评估) 原因: 专家评审能衡量质量(准确性、相关性、合规性、事实性等),但通常是抽样、离线、非真实用戶分布。 无法全面反映真实世界中的用戶行为指标、真实流量⻓尾、产品交互与上下文、业务目标等。 在“真实世界应用性能 ”这个问法下,专家评估更适合作为离线质量⻔槛或基准测试补充,而非最佳答案
B.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which strategy will evaluate the performance of a foundation model (FM) in real-world applications? The source-supported choice is A. Conducting A/B testing with users in a controlled environment.

C.zh: 錯誤。原因是，错误原因: 在训练集上评估会产生数据泄漏 /过拟合问题,指标虚高,不代表泛化能力,更不代表真实世界表现。 即使在测试集上看准确率,对生成式 FM也常不适用或不足;在训练集上更是明显不合理
C.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which strategy will evaluate the performance of a foundation model (FM) in real-world applications? The source-supported choice is A. Conducting A/B testing with users in a controlled environment.

D.zh: 錯誤。原因是，错误(不直接评估真实世界性能) 原因: 内部表征 /注意力分析属于可解释性与研究分析,可能帮助理解模型行为,但不等同于真实世界性能评估。 无法直接映射到用戶体验、业务指标或端到端任务成功率,也难以作为上线效果的可靠度量
D.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which strategy will evaluate the performance of a foundation model (FM) in real-world applications? The source-supported choice is A. Conducting A/B testing with users in a controlled environment.

answer_text.zh: A. 在受控环境中与用戶进行 A/B 测试
answer_text.en: A. Conducting A/B testing with users in a controlled environment
